user.title: Better ToDo
user.description: Set up the Better ToDo integration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is possible.

features.title: Better ToDo features
features.description: Enable or disable features. Disabled features are hidden everywhere.

data_description.priority_levels: 3 = high/medium/low, 5 = highest to lowest (1 is always the most important).

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notification service per person. Reminders and the daily summary are sent to the assigned persons. The dash means: no notifications for this person. Weekly and monthly tasks only enter the summary shortly before their period ends.

data.notify_unassigned_all: Send tasks without assignment to every configured person
data.summary_enabled: Send a daily summary of open tasks
data.summary_persistent: Also show the summary in the HA notification center

voice.title: Voice assistants & LLM agents
voice.description: Settings for the Better ToDo tool set that conversation agents can use (enable it in the agent's settings under "Control Home Assistant"). The default list receives new tasks when no list is named. One row per person and per area with an Assist satellite: the lists this person or area may read and change. Nothing selected = all lists. A rule for the person who is talking wins over a rule for the satellite's area.

get_tasks.name: Get tasks
get_tasks.description: Returns tasks with all their fields (tags, priority, assignment, due state) for scripts, automations and voice assistants. All filters are optional.

list.name: List
list.description: Only tasks from these lists (name or list of names).

assigned_to.name: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: Only tasks assigned to these persons (person entity or name).

include_unassigned.name: Include unassigned
include_unassigned.description: When filtering by person, also return tasks nobody is assigned to.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Only tasks with at least one of these tags.

due.name: Due
due.description: today = due today or overdue, overdue = overdue only, week = due within the next 7 days.

priority.name: Max. priority
priority.description: Only tasks with a priority of this value or more important (1 = most important).

sort.name: Sort
sort.description: priority = priority, then due date; due = due date first. Without it the stored order is kept.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Adds a task to a list (the list is created if it does not exist).

type.name: Type
type.description: Task type: simple, scheduled, after_completion or period.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Due date (first due date for recurring tasks).

visible_from.name: Visible from
visible_from.description: The task appears on this date.

lead_days.name: Lead days
lead_days.description: Show the task this many days before it is due.

assigned_to.name: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: Person entity (or list of them) the task is assigned to.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1 = most important, up to 3 or 5 depending on the configured levels; empty = none.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Minutes before the due moment (list or comma-separated, up to 5), e.g. 0 = at due time, 60 = 1 h before, 1440 = 1 day before.

overdue_repeat.name: Repeat while overdue
overdue_repeat.description: Send a reminder again every this many minutes after the due moment while the task is overdue (e.g. 1 = every minute, 15 = every 15 min, 1440 = daily).

location.name: Location condition
location.description: Deliver reminders only while the person is inside (or outside) a zone, otherwise hold them until they enter (or leave) it: zone = zone entity, mode = inside or outside.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Recurrence rule for scheduled tasks, e.g. freq=monthly, interval=1, day=1; optional months=[4,5,6] for active months.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Interval after completion, e.g. unit=months, value=1; optional months=[4,5,6] for active months.

period.name: Period
period.description: Period for habit tasks: week or month.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Marks a task as completed (by id or exact title).

title.name: Title
title.description: Exact task title (alternative to the id).

all.name: Complete all
all.description: Complete all outstanding occurrences at once.

list.name: List
list.description: List name to scope the title match (optional).

skip_task.name: Skip task
skip_task.description: Skips the current occurrence without completing it (streaks are frozen).

title.name: Title
title.description: Exact task title (alternative to the id).

list.name: List
list.description: List name to scope the title match (optional).

title.description: Exact task title (alternative to the id).

list.name: List
list.description: List name to scope the title match (optional).

update_task.name: Update task
update_task.description: Changes fields of an existing task (by id or exact title). Only the fields passed are changed.

title.name: Title
title.description: Exact task title (alternative to the id).

list.name: List
list.description: List name to scope the title match (optional).

new_list.name: New list
new_list.description: Move the task to this list (created if it does not exist).

type.name: Type
type.description: Task type: simple, scheduled, after_completion or period.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: Due date (next due date for recurring tasks).

visible_from.name: Visible from
visible_from.description: The task appears on this date.

lead_days.name: Lead days
lead_days.description: Show the task this many days before it is due.

overdue_repeat.name: Repeat while overdue
overdue_repeat.description: Send a reminder again every this many minutes after the due moment while the task is overdue (e.g. 1 = every minute, 15 = every 15 min, 1440 = daily). Empty or 0 turns it off.

assigned_to.name: Assigned to
assigned_to.description: Person entity (or list of them) the task is assigned to.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Replaces the recurrence rule, e.g. freq=weekly, interval=1, weekdays=[0,3], months=[4,5,6,7,8].

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Replaces the after-completion interval, e.g. unit=weeks, value=1, months=[4,5,6,7,8].

period.name: Period
period.description: Period for habit tasks: week or month.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: 1 = most important, up to 3 or 5 depending on the configured levels; empty = none.

reminders.name: Reminders
reminders.description: Replaces the reminders: minutes before the due moment (list or comma-separated, up to 5). Empty removes all.

location.name: Location condition
location.description: Deliver reminders only while the person is inside (or outside) a zone, otherwise hold them until they enter (or leave) it: zone = zone entity, mode = inside or outside. Empty removes the condition.
